title: Songbook and Harbor
author: Wendell Hartwell
blurb: Quentin Okafor, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
